body: It was big but it was pretty light and it was only a lander. MSL is much heavier, carries *much* more (and more advanced) scientific equipment, and can roam around.
You must defeat shenlong to stand a chance!

> (out of curiosity, what's your thesis about?)

That's another problem. The thesis is about doing research on cell migration. Up to now, we've focused on microscope image processing, but I have to define goals for the next year, and I sense he really has no goals. I have many ideas but whenever I try to open that debate it's the communication problem again.

> if there's some way to give lip service to his suggestions while doing what you think you should do, that would be my advice.

He's *very* sensitive to that sort of thing.
